identitySignals: Name matches exactly: the organization calls itself Community Responsive Education (CRE), and the agenda says Community Responsive Education (CRE).

Its services are consulting, teacher and curriculum development, and leadership coaching for schools and districts. This fits OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contract through the Academics and Instruction Department.
InfluenceWatch places the firm in Oakland, California, matching the agenda's Oakland, CA. The firm's own website does not state an address or city in the pages I could read.
research.notes: No registry record was found (California Secretary of State, SAM.gov or IRS), so the legal name, entity number, EIN and UEI are null. InfluenceWatch calls CRE a for-profit consulting firm, so the orgType is unverified by a registry. The only location evidence is InfluenceWatch's Oakland, California. The contact page could not be fetched, and no phone or address was found. The email hello@communityresponsive.org appeared on the Work With Us page in search results, but I did not confirm it by fetch. The search and fetch limit was hit before I could confirm the Oakland link or any OUSD connection from an independent source. Not suitable to publish without a registry or OUSD cross-check.

profile.summary: Community Responsive Education (CRE) is a consulting firm made up of educators, community leaders and wellness practitioners. It offers teacher and curriculum development, leadership coaching, workshops and strategic planning to schools, school districts and colleges.
